title: Move Gallery controllers into common runtime
scope: Move gravity, force, constraint release, motor, steering, dump-bed, kinematic and paint/cloth scene controls behind shared semantic actions.
acceptance: Every catalog scene declares actions without platform key, touch or widget codes in the runtime.
Desktop and mobile adapter tests drive the same controller transitions and reset results.
evidence: PASS: ctest --test-dir build-desktop-switch --output-on-failure -R 'parallel-mater-(camera-controller|gallery-registry|gallery-input|gallery-frame-timing)-tests' (4/4); catalog action contracts in tests/gallery/camera_controller_tests.cpp and tests/gallery/gallery_registry_contract_tests.cpp

PASS: Vulkan parallel-mater-gallery-session-contract-tests on NVIDIA RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU; mobile GallerySession and direct desktop runtime produce matching point release/reset transitions in tests/gallery/gallery_session_contract_tests.cpp
PASS: ANDROID_HOME=/home/thomas/Android/Sdk ./scripts/Build-AndroidGallery.sh (arm64-v8a debug APK); Android JNI dispatches the shared primary action and common controlled-step session path
